product.title: Kauai Eco Adventure Helicopter Tour

description.text: To fully appreciate the beauty of Hawaii’s ‘Garden Isle,’ take to the skies above Kauai on a helicopter tour in a new Eurocopter Eco-Star. Soar over the island’s diverse terrain, from rain-soaked Mount Waialeale and the waterfalls of Waiapuna to the dry red ravine of Waimea Canyon and the breathtaking emerald spires of the Na Pali Coast. Stops include Na Pali Coast, Waimea Canyon, Manawaiopuna Falls, Mount Waialeale. A two-way radio to communicate with the pilot and expansive viewing glass add to the unforgettable flight. Ideal for visitors basing on Kauai who want a guided island experience without coordinating transport, gear, or park logistics on their own.
